summary_en: This study tests ciltacabtagene autoleucel (cilta-cel) in people with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma, using either a fludarabine-free conditioning regimen or a cyclophosphamide and fludarabine regimen. Participants first receive 1 to 2 more cycles of standard induction therapy, then cyclophosphamide is given by IV infusion daily for 3 days, followed by cilta-cel IV infusion on Day 1. The main outcome measure is not stated; the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa ciltacabtagene autoleucel (cilta-cel) en personas con mieloma múltiple de diagnóstico reciente, usando un régimen de acondicionamiento sin fludarabina o un régimen de ciclofosfamida y fludarabina. Los participantes reciben primero de 1 a 2 ciclos más de terapia de inducción estándar, luego ciclofosfamida por infusión intravenosa diaria durante 3 días, seguida de la infusión intravenosa de cilta-cel el Día 1. La medida de resultado principal no está indicada; el estudio es de Fase 2.
who_for: Newly diagnosed multiple myeloma with measurable disease at diagnosis
Not a candidate for high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplant (for example, due to older age, other health conditions, or refusal)
Completed 3 to 5 cycles of induction therapy and reached at least partial response
Willing and able to follow the lifestyle restrictions in the protocol
not_for: Frailty index of 2 or higher on the Myeloma Geriatric Assessment
Known allergy, hypersensitivity, or intolerance to the study treatment or its active agents
Ongoing grade 2 or higher non-hematologic toxicity from induction therapy (except grade 2 bortezomib-related peripheral neuropathy)
